page.title: Collection reminders
page.sub: Who needs a reminder today, with the message ready
page.notice: ⚠️ The platform does not send messages itself; no messaging provider is connected yet. Here you see who is due a reminder today, prepare the text from your message template, and record what you actually sent.
page.days_before: Remind before the due date by
page.days_before_hint: days. Zero means reminding on the due date itself.
page.repeat_hint: days after it is overdue. A daily reminder is the fastest way to get it ignored by the tenant.
page.escalate_hint: days from the due date. Leave it empty to turn escalation off.
page.escalate_to_hint: An in-app notification on the notifications screen, not a text or email.
page.disabled: Reminders are off. Turn them on above to see the list.
page.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} due a reminder, oldest first. Handle these, then refresh the page.
page.message_hint: The text is saved as you sent it; templates change, and what matters later is what was actually said.
